issue_request: FHIR-45062 was an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-I change request for R6 asking for one or more additional transaction Bundle examples demonstrating complex item resolution, including creating a resource and referencing it later in the transaction and including at least one reference to something outside the bundle.
initial_application: The source change was already present before this reconciliation. additional_context: FHIR-I minutes from 2024-04-08 record a 9-0-0 motion to approve the example request. Bundle is active in source/fhir.ini, placing the source/bundle example files and list in current build scope. Searches found no direct Zulip discussion contradicting the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The existing complex request example uses urn:uuid fullUrls, creates resources that are referenced later in the same transaction, includes an outside-bundle conditional Organization reference, and the paired response shows assigned server ids and rewritten references.
